name: Chitose-Funabashi
tagline: Shinjuku in 20 minutes and Shibuya in 22 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Odakyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 20 minutes to Shinjuku, 22 minutes to Shibuya and 48 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 41.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 41.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 39.4 m to 51.3 m, a difference of 11.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 有隣病院, about 11 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 世田谷桜丘病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Odakyu Odawara Line.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Kyodo is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is, but Chitose-Funabashi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Odakyu Odawara Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
